# the one bought at 1.35, and 50 USD of the one borrowed at 1.30. Cost released
# is 135.00 + 65.00 = 200.00 CAD, so $residual$ books an 8.50 CAD gain.

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"

		value: "-135.00"

	Assets:Bank:USD -50.00 USD

		value: "-65.00"

	Assets:Bank 208.50 CAD
